xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3231: Issue-row artifact click-throughs: xBRIEF chip → full-screen viewer, tasks chip → tasks viewer (resurrect beads panel), PRD affordance → markdown viewer

plan.title: Issue-row artifact click-throughs: xBRIEF chip → full-screen viewer, tasks chip → tasks viewer (resurrect beads panel), PRD affordance → markdown viewer
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PRD draft (workspace; promoted to drafts/ on overdeck-state at finalize)

metadata.sizeJustification: PAN-3231 explicitly mandates single-issue delivery: 'Deliver as one feature: chips clickable + full-screen popup + tasks viewer + PRD viewer + mockup step. No partial delivery.' The 7th subsystem over the limit comes from the three viewers necessarily spanning frontend components, the store, one route module, one lib read door, and docs; each slice is still small and the total files (23) stays under the 25-file limit. The frontend file overlaps (store.ts, App.tsx, FeatureItem.tsx) are additive registrations executed serially by one work agent in one workspace.

narratives.Problem: The issue-row chip strip (ResourceStrip in FeatureItem.tsx) shows that xBRIEF, tasks, and planning artifacts exist, but no chip opens anything. Operators must detour to kanban or the drawer Plan tab to see the plan, there is no tasks click-through from the tree, and the PRD has no affordance at all.
narratives.Proposal: Make the artifacts clickable through store-driven, globally mounted overlays following the IssueDrawer precedent: (1) xBRIEF chip and the embedded viewers (DrawerPlanPanel, PlanMapCard) open a new full-screen XBriefFullscreen shell reusing the presentational XBriefViewer with its List/DAG/Raw toggle, fed by the canonical useWorkspacePlanQuery hook; the shell layout is operator-approved via interactive HTML mockups before the build. (2) The tasks chip opens the resurrected beads-panel UX (TasksPanel, already xBRIEF-checklist-fed) in a dialog; the legacy self-fetching TasksDialog body with dead beads status vocabulary is replaced by TasksPanel. (3) A new PRD chip appears when a state-plane draft exists (resource discovery gains a 'prd' source via the prd-locations read door) and opens a ChatMarkdown-based viewer fed by a new GET /api/issues/:id/prd endpoint with no continue.json fallback.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No URL deep-linking / router integration for the new overlays
- No consolidation of the four pre-existing plan query cache keys beyond files already touched; no renaming keys used by untouched components
- No behavior change to the kanban XBriefDialog entry point
- No PRD editing — view only
- No new markdown renderer; no Streamdown imports outside ChatMarkdown.tsx
- No changes to pan task semantics, the task write door, or xBRIEF statuses
- No per-mount redesign of the global 'xbrief-viewer-tab' localStorage key
- No shared generic Dialog primitive refactor across existing hand-rolled overlays

autoDecisions.summary: Full-screen viewer is store-driven state + a global App.tsx mount (IssueDrawer precedent), not a locally hosted dialog
autoDecisions.rationale: The two openers (tree chip, drawer Plan tab) live in different component trees; store-driven overlay state is the codebase's canonical mechanism (openIssue, store.ts:163-168) and avoids prop drilling.

autoDecisions.summary: Chips call useDashboardStore actions directly instead of threading new callbacks through CommandDeck → ProjectNode → FeatureItem
autoDecisions.rationale: FeatureItem already consumes the store (openIssue at line 1032); prop drilling four levels for three new callbacks adds surface without benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: Tasks viewer reuses TasksPanel rather than restoring the pre-PAN-2648 beads components from git history
autoDecisions.rationale: The beads removal commit renamed BeadsTasksPanel → TasksPanel preserving the UX, and PAN-2696 already rewired it to the xBRIEF checklist (/api/issues/:id/tasks serves the merged view pan task mutates). Resurrection is already done; only the chip wiring is missing.

autoDecisions.summary: A dedicated GET /api/issues/:id/prd endpoint is added instead of reusing GET /api/command-deck/planning/:issueId
autoDecisions.rationale: The planning endpoint substitutes continue.json content when no PRD exists (command-deck.ts:829) and bundles transcripts/notes; a PRD viewer must show honest 404/empty state and stay lightweight. The new route goes through the same prd-locations read door.

autoDecisions.summary: ChatMarkdown is the markdown viewer component (not MarkdownModal, not a new renderer)
autoDecisions.rationale: ChatMarkdown is the canonical dual renderer (react-markdown default, Streamdown behind the experimental setting) with file-link chips and an error boundary; MarkdownModal uses raw ReactMarkdown without those. The issue asked planning to confirm the canonical component — confirmed by code survey.

autoDecisions.summary: The mockup approval gate blocks only the xBRIEF full-screen chain (shell, chip click, embedded expand); tasks and PRD items proceed in parallel
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's design requirement names only the full-screen xBRIEF viewer. Serializing unrelated slices on an operator response would idle the pipeline without design benefit.

autoDecisions.summary: Mockups are produced by the work agent as work item 1 with an AskUserQuestion operator gate, not during auto planning
autoDecisions.rationale: Auto mode has no operator to review interactively; the AUQ surfaces in the dashboard Decisions queue and mechanically satisfies 'mockups reviewed by the operator before the build'.

autoDecisions.summary: The xBRIEF full-screen overlay uses z-[110], above IssueDrawer's z-[100]
autoDecisions.rationale: The drawer's own expand affordance must layer the viewer on top of the open drawer.

items.title: Interactive full-screen xBRIEF viewer mockups + operator approval gate

expected_outputs: mockup HTML file exists and is non-empty; operator approval recorded via AskUserQuestion before dependent items start

narrative.Action: Author a self-contained interactive HTML mockup at docs/design/pan-3231-xbrief-fullscreen.html showing the full-screen List view, full-screen DAG view, the List/DAG/Raw toggle, and how item status / acceptance-criteria checks / lane-readiness info read at a glance at full width. Follow design/style-guide/STYLE-GUIDE.md v1.2 (DM Sans, SF Mono for identifiers only, font-medium max, one color signal per row); precedent: docs/design/issue-cockpit-full-width-conversation.html. Then ask the operator for approval via a self-contained AskUserQuestion (state the mockup path, offer approve / request-changes with consequences) and iterate until approved. Record the approval in .overdeck/continue.json decisions and later in the PR description.
